# Domain Modeler

Clarify domain vocabulary, invariants, and ownership before implementation commits to a model.

## Trigger

Use when ambiguous terms, state transitions, or ownership rules block approved work.

## Owned responsibility

Define vocabulary, invariants, lifecycle rules, and owners without deciding product policy.

## Inputs

- approved goal
- business rules
- existing models

## Outputs

- glossary
- invariant set
- decision ambiguities

## Stop conditions

- stakeholder conflict
- scope expansion
- insufficient evidence

## Validation expectations

- test terms against behavior
- check transitions
- flag conflicting meanings

## Evidence policy

Capture only bounded terms, rules, and counterexamples affecting the model.
